m2-systematic-wiring.title: Replace SYSTEMATIC_FLOOR/_apply_floor with G1 systematic_budget wiring
m2-systematic-wiring.imperative: Grep the tree for every SYSTEMATIC_FLOOR/_apply_floor importer/user (confirmed: only estimate_store.py itself). Remove SYSTEMATIC_FLOOR + _apply_floor; add a guarded per-session systematic_budget() call (mirroring the existing _fused_cda_fields guard pattern) whose (shared_rel, session_rel) per axis inflates each axis's fit sigma in quadrature into the stored {axis}_sigma, and populates the new {axis}_shared_sigma with the absolute shared component. Cover all 8 axes (cda incl. power_drag_area_m2, p_max, a_b, b_b, a_t, b_t, A0, A2). When the budget cannot be computed (missing rho/mass/braking/traction), fall back to a documented conservative constant for cda/p_max/A0 (matching the retired floor's magnitude) rather than silently dropping to zero -- honest-wide over optimistic. Reconcile every existing estimate_store test whose numeric assertions assumed the old blind 4% floor; name each reconciled test in the result.

postconditions.statement: SYSTEMATIC_FLOOR removed with no dangling importer; sigma now reflects the per-session G1 budget; estimate_store tests green

m3-status.title: Real explicit-unknown {axis}_status resolution
m3-status.imperative: In record_from_estimate/error_record, set {axis}_status='resolved' when genuinely measured this session; 'unresolved' for theta_R (always), a degenerate PowerDrag cda/p_max, and any absent (None) lateral/coast view (A0/A2/theta_R). An unresolved axis's sigma must carry the UNRESOLVED_AXIS_SIGMA_FRAC reserved-wide sentinel, not a confident-narrow value. Add a read-time helper/normalization treating a NULL status (legacy row) as unresolved. Write a property test asserting unresolved sigma is numerically >> resolved sigma for: theta_R, degenerate PowerDrag, absent lateral, and a genuinely-measured CdA (resolved, finite, not reserved-wide).

postconditions.statement: status predicate real; property test passes; existing estimate_store status tests still green

constraints: unresolved carries reserved wide sigma, never a confident ~0

m4-pooling-floor.title: pool_random_effects shared_floor arg
m4-pooling-floor.imperative: Add a shared_floor arg to pool_random_effects (documented units: absolute, same units as values/sigmas); after computing sigma_mu, floor it via sqrt(sigma_mu**2 + shared_floor**2). Add a test: with shared_floor=0 sigma_mu shrinks toward 0 as n grows; with a nonzero shared_floor sigma_mu plateaus at the floor instead of shrinking below it.
constraints: pooling cannot average away a shared bias

m5-pool-driver-floor.title: pool_store threads shared_floor non-optionally
m5-pool-driver-floor.imperative: Thread shared_floor through pool_driver.pool_store: derive a per-param representative shared sigma from the store's {axis}_shared_sigma column (e.g. median across the pooled sessions for that constructor+param; gracefully 0.0 when the column has no data for that param, e.g. legacy rows) and pass it to pool_random_effects at every call site -- no silent-unfloored path. Add a test asserting the floor is actually passed/applied at the pool_store site, and reconcile any existing pool_driver test whose synthetic EstimateRecord fixtures (no shared_sigma set) would otherwise assume an unfloored pool.

postconditions.statement: pool_store always passes shared_floor; test proves it; existing pool_driver tests still green

constraints: non-optional wiring at the pool_store call site
